input.command:
python3 -c '
# Pose at obs 74:
# From obs 73 (pose 0.7071, 0.7071, theta=45), turned -45 -> theta=0, moved 0.5 -> X = 0.7071, Y = 1.2071.
import cv2, numpy as np

img = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0074.png")

# Pot 2:
mask_pot = (img[:,:,2] > 120) & (img[:,:,0] < 80) & (img[:,:,1] < 100)
y_p, x_p = np.where(mask_pot)
if len(x_p) > 0:
    print(f"Pot 2: x=[{x_p.min()}, {x_p.max()}], y=[{y_p.min()}, {y_p.max()}], bottom_y={y_p.max()}, center_x={x_p.mean():.1f}")

# Table legs:
# Brown table: R > 100, G ~ 50-80, B ~ 10-40
mask_table = (img[:,:,2] > 90) & (img[:,:,2] < 160) & (img[:,:,1] > 40) & (img[:,:,1] < 100) & (img[:,:,0] < 50)
y_t, x_t = np.where(mask_table)
if len(x_t) > 0:
    print(f"Table in obs 74: x=[{x_t.min()}, {x_t.max()}], y=[{y_t.min()}, {y_t.max()}]")
'
